name: Silver Leaf Cafe

nadir.desc: The lot holds a large lodge-style commercial building with a complex brown multi-gabled shingle roof, dormers, and a square tower with a pyramidal cap|A paved parking lot with marked spaces and handicapped accessible spaces lies along front of the building|A landscaped pond with small islands and fountain jets sits behind the building|A semi-circular patio with outdoor tables overlooks the pond|Trees, including evergreens and trees with red autumn foliage, are spaced through the parking lot and around the building.

alpha.desc: The marked parking lot dominates the area in front of the building|A central gabled overhang marks a main entry area screened by evergreen trees|Walkways connect the lot to the building|A wooden enclosure sits on one end of the lot|The square tower and the pond beyond the building are visible past the roof line.

bravo.desc: From the left side of the building the square clock tower on the opposite side is visible along with stone and wood exterior finishes, and roof gables|A small parking lot and a service area with a wooden enclosure sit on the left side of the building|HVAC or utility equipment is visible near the enclosure|Trees with red foliage stand in the front lot islands|The pond and patio remain visible past the far side of the building.

charlie.desc: The back side of the building shows a stone patio with outdoor seating overlooking the pond with fountain jets|A clock tower rises near one wing, and patio umbrellas are visible near outdoor seating below the tower|Walkways and landscaping wrap the water edge|Trees frame the patio and the building facade facing the pond.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows additional gabled wings, windows, and a stone chimney on one section|The pond with islands and fountains lies along this side|The front parking lot and circulation path wrap the other side of the building|Evergreen and deciduous trees screen portions of the walls and walkways.

considerations: A large parking lot that runs along the front side of the building, with marked spaces and partial circulation. A service pad and wooden enclosure sit at one end of the lot. Pedestrian access continues around the building to a patio overlooking the pond. No gates are visible surrounding the property. Trees and landscaping create narrow walkway segments between the lot and some entries.
clarifications: Which exterior door is the public entrance for suite 200, and which doors serve other suites in the building? Is there a separate service or loading entrance, and is it restricted after hours? Are any parking lot access points gated after hours? Which patio seating areas are open to Market patrons versus other tenants? Are exterior doors secured by a lock or code outside business hours?
